get_model_url_by_name: get the download URL for a named model from the ModelCatalog using ModelCatalog.get(name)
list_imagenet_pretrained_models: list all ImageNet pretrained model names available in ModelCatalog.C2_IMAGENET_MODELS dictionary
list_detectron_baseline_models: list all Detectron COCO baseline model names available in ModelCatalog.C2_DETECTRON_MODELS dictionary
resolve_catalog_path: resolve a catalog:// prefixed path to its local file path using ModelCatalogHandler
open_catalog_model_file: open a model file from the catalog using PathManager.open with a catalog:// URL
